extName.description: The extension's name, shown in the browser toolbar and extensions management page.

extDescription.message: Blocks ads, trackers and pop-up tabs, with no nag screens.
extDescription.description: The extension's short description, shown on the extensions management page and store listing.

popupOnboardingCard.message: Moat blocks ads and trackers on every site. If a site breaks, pause Moat there with this site's switch.

popupBudgetNotice.message: Some blocking is off. Your browser's limit for blocking extensions is full.

popupProtectionNone.message: Nothing to block on this page

popupProtectionLight.message: A few ads and trackers blocked

popupProtectionModerate.message: Quite a few ads and trackers blocked

popupProtectionHeavy.message: Lots of ads and trackers blocked

popupOverrideFingerprintSub.message: Makes your browser look slightly different each visit, so sites can't recognize you.

popupOverrideCookieBannerSub.message: Automatically clicks “reject” on cookie banners for you.

popupOverrideFeedAdsSub.message: Hides sponsored and promoted posts as you scroll.

popupOverrideSeoSpamSub.message: Hides search results from a list of known low-quality sites.

popupFreshStartConfirm.message: Click again to clear. You'll be signed out of this site.

popupFreshStartError.message: Couldn't clear this site's data. Reload the page and try again.

popupLoadError.message: Couldn't load this page's details. Click Moat's icon again.

optionsCookiesToggleHint.message: Stops sites following you from one website to the next.

optionsWebrtcToggleHint.message: Stops pages finding your real IP address through video-call features, even behind a VPN.

optionsFingerprintRotateToggleLabel.message: Use a new disguise each time you restart

optionsGrayscaleToggleHint.message: Video ads Moat can't block are dimmed while they play.

optionsFeedScanToggleHint.message: Removes sponsored posts from Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube feeds.

optionsConsentRejectToggleHint.message: Picks the option that shares the least, so you don't have to.

optionsCnameChromeDohHint.message: On Chrome, Moat asks Cloudflare where hidden trackers really point. It can miss the first one on a site. Firefox does this privately by itself.

optionsExceptionsHint.message: Ads and trackers load normally on these sites. Known dangerous sites stay blocked. Add one here, or pause a site from Moat's icon while you're on it.

optionsFilterBudgetWarning.message: Some of Moat's filter lists couldn't turn on. Browsers limit how many blocking rules all extensions can use together. Another ad blocker or privacy extension can use up that limit. Turn one of them off, or turn off a list here.

optionsFilterBudgetDetail.message: Your browser says $COUNT$ rules are left for all your extensions together. Still low after turning off other extensions and reloading Moat? Turn off a list here. Annoyances and Cookie Notices are good ones to try first.

optionsFilterBudgetDropped.message: $NAMES$ are off for now to stay within your browser's limit.

optionsFilterBudgetDroppedBadge.message: Off to stay within the browser limit

optionsIndividualListsHint.message: The lists behind your blocking level. Turning one on or off here makes it your own mix.

optionsLoadListsError.message: Couldn't load filter lists. Reload this page to try again.

optionsBlockedSitesHint.message: Always block these sites, whatever the filter lists say.

optionsAddDomainInvalid.message: Enter a site address like example.com.

optionsAddDomainFailed.message: Couldn't add that domain. Try again.

optionsAllowedSitesHint.message: Lets this address load on every site, even if a filter list blocks it. Other ads on the page stay blocked.

optionsHiddenElementsHint.message: Parts of pages you hid. Remove one to bring it back.

optionsTrackersEmpty.message: No trackers found on the last tab you had open.

optionsTrackersUnsupported.message: This detailed tracker list only works in Chrome for now. Firefox doesn't support it yet.

optionsSyncToggleHint.message: Stored by your browser account. No browsing data is included.

optionsSyncStatusFailed.message: Couldn't sync your settings on $WHEN$. You may have more rules or sites than your browser's sync storage can hold. They're still saved on this device.

presetHintCustom.message: A mix you've set up yourself.

optionsLiveStatusFailed.message: The last update failed on $WHEN$. Moat keeps using the lists it has until the next try.

optionsImportedInvalid.message: That file doesn't look like a valid Moat settings export.

optionsImportReadError.message: Couldn't read that file. Choose a backup file saved by Moat.

leakedPasswordWarning.message: This password has appeared in a known data breach.

popupPermissionGuardIntro.message: This site asked for your camera, microphone or location. Moat stopped it.

optionsFingerprintDrawerDesc.message: Makes it harder for sites to recognize your device.

optionsFingerprintCaution.message: Can occasionally break a CAPTCHA or a bank's device check. If a site misbehaves, turn this off first.

optionsCnameDrawerDesc.message: Finds trackers that hide behind a website's own address.

optionsSearchSlopDrawerDesc.message: Filters known content-farm sites out of your search results.

optionsSearchSlopCaution.message: Each hidden batch stays one click away behind a "Show" link.

optionsLeakedPasswordDrawerDesc.message: Tells you if a password you type has appeared in a data breach.

optionsLeakedPasswordCaution.message: Only a short scrambled piece of it is ever checked.

optionsPermissionGuardMergedDesc.message: Stops pages asking for your camera, microphone or location the moment they load. Allow a site from the popup when you trust it.

optionsFingerprintMetricLabel.message: sites that saw a disguised device this week

optionsFirefoxRFPToggleHint.message: Turns on a deeper device-disguise mode built into Firefox itself. It reaches further than Moat can on its own: window size, fonts, timezone, and more.

optionsFirefoxRFPCaution.message: Can be more disruptive than Moat's own fingerprint protection above. It changes real browser behavior, not just what a page can see, so it's worth trying for a few days before relying on it.

optionsFirefoxFPIToggleLabel.message: Stop trackers linking you across sites

optionsFirefoxFPIToggleHint.message: Keeps every site's stored data separate, so the same tracker embedded on two different sites can't connect what it saw on each.

optionsFirefoxFPICaution.message: Can break logging in with a Google or Facebook account on a third-party site. If a login stops working, pause this first.

optionsPickElementFailed.message: Couldn't start there. Moat can't run on browser pages or extension stores. Open a website and try again.

optionsRuleStaleMeta.message: Hasn't matched in 30 days. The site probably changed.

optionsTrackersDesc.message: Companies Moat stopped this week. Counted on your device and never uploaded.

warningLede.message: Your organization's security policy blocks this site. It isn't on one of Moat's own lists.

warningOverrideNote.message: This sends a note to your organization's security team to review. It doesn't unblock the site.

warningReasonPlaceholder.message: Why do you think this was blocked in error?

warningGoesToIT.message: Goes to your IT team, not to Moat.

warningReportedSuccess.message: Reported to your security team. This page stays blocked until they review it.

warningReportedError.message: Couldn't send the report. Try again in a moment.

optionsMigrationImportHint.message: Paste rules exported from uBlock Origin, AdGuard or a similar blocker. Moat imports blocked and allowed sites, and rules that hide parts of a site. Other rule types are skipped.

optionsBackupDesc.message: Keep your settings, rules and paused sites safe, or carry them to another computer.

optionsAboutDesc.message: What this version is, and everything that ever leaves your device.

optionsDisclosureBlockingSent.message: Nothing. Runs entirely on your device.

optionsDisclosureUpdatesSent.message: Filter fixes and today's phishing and scam lists, downloaded once a day as signed files. Nothing about you is sent.

optionsDisclosureBreachSent.message: A short scrambled fragment of a password, never the password itself

optionsDisclosureSyncSent.message: Your Moat settings. No browsing data.

optionsDisclosureStatsSent.message: Nothing leaves your device. Counts stay stored locally.

diagnosticsDesc.message: What Moat actually did on the active tab, and what it was supposed to do but didn't.

diagnosticsHeroLabel.message: heuristics that apply here fired on this page load

diagnosticsHeuristicsNote.message: content scripts that read the page. They break when a site changes its markup.

diagnosticsMatchesEmpty.message: No matches recorded yet for this tab. Reload the page and refresh.

optionsImportNoChanges.message: This file matches your current settings. Nothing would change.

levelTitle.description: Protection page: the card where you pick Light, Balanced or Strict.

levelLead.message: Balanced suits most people. Pick Strict for more privacy, or Light if sites keep breaking.

levelLightDesc.message: Blocks ads, pop-ups, and dangerous sites like scams and malware. Trackers still load, so sites that depend on them keep working.

levelBalancedDesc.message: Everything in Light, plus trackers, tracking added to links, and fake login sites. Recommended.

levelStrictDesc.message: Everything in Balanced, plus cookie banners and social media buttons. It also stops sites recognizing your device, following you between sites, or seeing your IP address. A few sites may break.

levelCustomNote.message: You're using your own mix of filter lists.
levelCustomNote.description: Settings > Blocking level: note under the level cards when the filter lists don't match any level. Followed by a link to Filter lists.

featuresLead.message: Clear away cookie banners, sponsored posts and other clutter. Turn on the ones you want.

pausedEmptyHint.message: Pause a site you trust to let its ads and trackers load.

hiddenEmptyHint.message: Click Moat's icon, choose Hide something on this page, then click what you want gone.

advBudgetLine.message: Chrome lets all your extensions use $LIMIT$ blocking rules in total. Moat packs its $ENTRIES$ filter entries into $USED$ of them.

advPrivacyLead.message: Extra protection against being followed and identified. Off by default because a few sites can break.

advRulesLead.message: Your own rules. They always win over the filter lists.

advTrackersSummary.message: Of this week's blocks, $ATTEMPTS$ came from $COMPANIES$ companies Moat can name.
advTrackersSummary.description: Settings > Overview > Trackers: how much of the week's total came from companies Moat can name. A part of the headline number, not a separate total.

advTrackersSummaryOne.message: Of this week's blocks, $ATTEMPTS$ came from one company Moat can name.
advTrackersSummaryOne.description: Settings > Overview > Trackers: the same line as advTrackersSummary when exactly one company was named.

advTrackersOnTab.message: On the tab you last used

tourHowLede.message: Moat stops ads and trackers before they download, not after they appear.

tourHow1Sub.message: Images, scripts, ads and trackers, often hundreds per page.

tourHow2Title.message: Moat checks each one on your device

tourHow2Sub.message: It checks each request against hundreds of thousands of rules from public filter lists. Nothing leaves your device.

tourHow3Sub.message: And neither does anything they would have loaded next.

tourHow4Sub.message: Empty ad boxes fold away. Cookie banners get a “reject” where the site allows it.

tourPinTitle.message: Pin Moat next to the address bar

tourPinLede.message: Then its icon shows how much each page tried to load, and you can pause it on a site in one click.

tourPinStep1.message: Click the puzzle piece in your toolbar.

tourPinWatching.message: This tab updates as soon as you pin it.

tourPinBenefit1.message: See each page's count at a glance

tourPinBenefit2.message: Pause Moat if a site breaks

tourPopupLede.message: Click Moat's icon on any page. This is what it showed on weather.com.

tourLegend1Title.message: What this page tried to load

tourLegend1Sub.message: Split into ads, trackers and pop-ups.

tourLegend2Sub.message: Only for this site. Everywhere else stays protected.

tourLegend3Sub.message: Point at it, click, and it stays gone.

tourFlowHint.message: What happened on weather.com, request by request

tourPinTryHint.message: Try it here first. The real buttons are in your toolbar.

tourMenuAccess.message: Full access. These extensions can see and change information on this site.

tourPopupHint.message: Moat's popup on weather.com, with the numbers from that visit

tourWeatherBeforeAlt.message: weather.com without Moat: a large product ad fills the top of the page

tourWeatherAfterAlt.message: weather.com with Moat: the ad is gone and the story moves up

tourWeatherFact1.message: The ad at the top is gone

tourForbesBeforeAlt.message: forbes.com without Moat: a banner ad sits under the menu

tourForbesAfterAlt.message: forbes.com with Moat: the banner is gone

tourForbesFact1.message: The banner under the menu is gone

tourSeeLede.message: This is $SITE$, loaded twice in Chrome: once on its own and once with Moat. Flip the switch to compare.

tourPinStep2Firefox.message: Click the gear next to Moat, then Pin to Toolbar.

tourPinStep2Chrome.message: Click the pin next to Moat.

tourPinDone.message: Pinned. Moat is next to your address bar.

tourWeatherFact1Sub.message: The story moves up into its place.

tourSeeFact2Sub.message: The ad and the trackers behind it never loaded, so the page had less to fetch.

tourSeeFact3Sub.message: This happens on every site, on your device, from the moment Moat is installed.

optionsRuleHitsNone.message: not seen on a page yet

pageLeadBlocking.message: How much to block, and the extras on top

aboutFlowsNothing.message: With your current settings, nothing about your browsing leaves your device.

aboutFlowsSome.message: A feature you turned on sends a little data. Each one is listed below.

aboutShortcutDesc.message: Turns Moat on or off on every site.

pageLeadOverview.message: What Moat did for you this week

ovWeekLabel.message: ads, trackers and pop-ups stopped this week

ovWeekEmpty.message: Nothing blocked yet this week. Browse a few sites and this fills in.

explainHowItWorks.description: Heading of the Settings side panel that pictures how a setting works, and the button on each setting that shows that picture.

explainLevels.message: Each level includes everything in the one before it, then blocks a bit more.
explainLevels.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainConsentReject.message: When a site shows a cookie banner, Moat picks the choice that shares the least, so you never have to click it.
explainConsentReject.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainGrayscale.message: Some video ads come from the same server as the video, so blocking them would stop the video too. Moat dims them while they play.
explainGrayscale.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainFeedScan.message: As you scroll, Moat looks for the Sponsored label on posts and takes those posts out of your feed.
explainFeedScan.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainLeakedPassword.message: Moat checks a short scrambled piece of a password you type against known breaches. Your password itself never leaves your computer.
explainLeakedPassword.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainCookies.message: A tracker on one site leaves a cookie so it can spot you on the next one. Moat stops sites from sharing those cookies.
explainCookies.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainWebrtc.message: Video-call features can show a page your real IP address, even behind a VPN. Moat keeps it hidden.
explainWebrtc.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainFingerprint.message: Sites can recognize you from details like your screen, fonts and graphics card. Moat changes those details slightly on every visit.
explainFingerprint.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainCname.message: Some trackers hide behind the site's own address. Moat looks up where that address really points and blocks it if it's a tracker.
explainCname.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainSearchSlop.message: Results from known content farms fold away behind a Show link, so they're still one click away.
explainSearchSlop.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainPermissionGuard.message: Pages that ask for your camera, microphone or location as soon as they load are stopped. Allow a site from Moat's popup when you trust it.
explainPermissionGuard.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainLists.message: Filter lists are shared blocklists that their authors keep up to date. Moat combines the lists for your level into one set of rules.
explainLists.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainPaused.message: On a paused site, ads and trackers load as usual. Known dangerous sites stay blocked.
explainPaused.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainHidden.message: Point at anything on a page and click it. Moat hides it there every time you visit.
explainHidden.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainRules.message: Your own rules beat the filter lists. Always block a site, or never block one a list gets wrong.
explainRules.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

explainBackup.message: A backup is a plain text file you can open and read. Sync keeps the same settings on your other computers.
explainBackup.description: Caption under the animated "How it works" picture for one setting in Settings. One or two plain sentences.

advTrackersEmptyWeek.message: None yet this week. Companies show up here as Moat stops their trackers while you browse.

reportPageTitle.description: Title of the Report a problem page.

reportLead.message: Tell Moat's developer what went wrong. You'll see everything that gets sent before you send it.
reportLead.description: Intro under the Report a problem title.

reportSiteLabel.description: Label for the site the report is about.

reportWhatLabel.description: Question above the four problem categories.

popupPausedOn.message: Moat is paused on $HOST$. Reload the page to apply it.
popupPausedOn.description: Popup banner on a paused site. $HOST$ is the site's address.

popupPausedHere.description: Popup banner on a site that was already paused when the popup opened. $HOST$ is the site's address.

popupUpdated.description: Popup notice after an update, followed by a 'See what's new' link.

backupSavesFile.message: Saves $FILE$, a plain text file you can open and read.
backupSavesFile.description: Settings > Backup: under Save a backup. $FILE$ is the file name, e.g. moat-settings-2026-09-29.json.

aboutManagedNote.message: Your organization manages this copy of Moat and set the policies shown here. Your administrator can see and change those policies, but not your browsing history.
aboutManagedNote.description: Settings > About: note shown on installs managed by an organization.

popupInternalPage.message: Moat doesn't run on browser pages like this one. Open a website to see what it blocks there.
popupInternalPage.description: Popup on a new tab, browser settings or extension store page, where Moat can't run.

ruleLabelNamed.description: Settings > Hidden on pages: what a hidden item is. $KIND$ is Image, Link, Box and so on; $NAME$ is the name the page gave it.

diagnosticsBlockedOnly.description: Diagnostics: filter above the rule-match log, on by default. Off also shows allow exceptions, header edits and URL cleaning.

diagnosticsShowMore.description: Diagnostics: button under the log that shows the next rows.

diagnosticsSilentGrayscale.message: No ad to dim yet. If that seems wrong, YouTube's player markup may have changed.
diagnosticsSilentGrayscale.description: Diagnostics: why Dim YouTube ads hasn't acted yet.

diagnosticsSilentFeed.message: Nothing sponsored has shown up in the feed yet. Could also mean the site's markup changed.
diagnosticsSilentFeed.description: Diagnostics: why Hide sponsored posts hasn't acted yet.

diagnosticsSilentConsent.message: This page probably didn't show a cookie banner.
diagnosticsSilentConsent.description: Diagnostics: why Reject cookie banners hasn't acted.

diagnosticsSilentSearchSlop.message: None of this search's results matched the filter.
diagnosticsSilentSearchSlop.description: Diagnostics: why the low-quality results filter hasn't acted.

diagnosticsSilentLeakedPassword.message: Only runs once you actually type a password into a field on this page.
diagnosticsSilentLeakedPassword.description: Diagnostics: why the leaked-password check hasn't acted.

diagnosticsSilentFingerprint.message: Nothing needed disguising on this page load.
diagnosticsSilentFingerprint.description: Diagnostics: why device protection hasn't acted.

diagnosticsSilentCname.message: This page probably has no disguised trackers to catch.
diagnosticsSilentCname.description: Diagnostics: why Catch hidden trackers hasn't acted.

diagnosticsOffTag.description: Diagnostics: tag after a check that's turned off.

diagnosticsFiredTimes.message: Times it acted on this page: $COUNT$
diagnosticsFiredTimes.description: Diagnostics: how often a check acted on this page load.

diagnosticsLastAt.description: Diagnostics: time a check last acted.

diagnosticsScopeNote.message: Not listed because they don't apply to this page: $NAMES$.
diagnosticsScopeNote.description: Diagnostics: the checks that don't apply to this page, as a comma-separated list.

diagnosticsPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the Diagnostics page.

settingsPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the Settings page.

warningPageTitle.description: Browser tab title of the page shown instead of a site your organization blocks.

optionsMigrationImportBlocked.description: Settings > Backup > Import from another blocker: how many sites were added to Always block.

optionsMigrationImportAllowed.description: Import result: how many sites were added to Never block.

optionsMigrationImportCosmetic.description: Import result: how many hidden-item rules were added.

optionsMigrationImportAdded.description: Import result. $PARTS$ is the counts above joined with ' · '.

optionsMigrationImportNothingNew.message: Nothing new to add. Every rule Moat recognized was already saved.
optionsMigrationImportNothingNew.description: Import result when everything was already there.

optionsMigrationImportSkipped.description: Import result: lines in a format Moat doesn't support.

optionsMigrationImportNothingFound.message: Moat didn't recognize any rules in that text. Paste rules exported from uBlock Origin or AdGuard.
optionsMigrationImportNothingFound.description: Import result when nothing usable was pasted.

pickerHintTouch.description: Picker hint on touch screens (phones), shown instead of the Esc hint. Followed by a Cancel button.

advBudgetLineFirefox.message: Firefox lets each extension use $LIMIT$ blocking rules. Moat packs $ENTRIES$ filter entries into $USED$ of them and turns on the most important lists that fit.
advBudgetLineFirefox.description: Settings > Filter lists on Firefox: its per-extension rule limit and how much Moat uses.

navCollapse.description: Settings menu button: folds the sidebar to icons.

navExpand.description: Settings menu button: unfolds the icon rail to the full sidebar.

navOpen.description: Settings menu button on narrow windows: opens the menu drawer.

navClose.description: Settings menu button while the menu drawer is open.

secLists.description: Protection page: the card with the filter lists.

jumpLabel.description: Accessible name for the row of jump links at the top of a Settings page.

pageLeadProtection.message: How much Moat blocks, and the extras on top
pageLeadProtection.description: Subtitle of the Protection page in Settings.

listSectionOnCount.description: How many lists in a group are switched on.

listAdsName.description: Filter list name: what it stops.

listAdsDesc.message: Banners, video ads and ad scripts.

listOisdDesc.message: Catches what the lists above miss.

navExceptions.description: Settings menu item: paused sites, hidden parts of pages and your own rules.

pageLeadExceptions.message: Sites, parts of pages and rules where you made your own choice

tabPaused.description: Exceptions page tab: sites where Moat is paused.

tabHidden.description: Exceptions page tab: parts of pages you hid.

tabRules.description: Exceptions page tab: sites you always block or never block.
